_comment: MoveAttrs registry entries NOT examined by state-builder's runtime flag extraction. Families: (covered) the information is already captured by an encoded v6/v7 flag or state field; (calc-variant) a power/accuracy/type/category formula variant subsumed by the has_variable_* flags; (cosmetic/internal) messaging, sequencing or base classes with no decision semantics; (BACKLOG:) encode-worthy, tracked in src/rl/docs/OBSERVATION_CHUNKS.md.

excluded.MoveEffectAttr: internal: abstract base class — concrete subclasses classified individually
excluded.OverrideMoveEffectAttr: internal: abstract base for charge/recharge overrides
excluded.CallMoveAttr: internal: abstract base — calls_random_move/calls_moveset_move cover the concrete subclasses
excluded.AddBattlerTagHeaderAttr: cosmetic: header variant of AddBattlerTagAttr (the tag itself is caught by the instanceof check)
excluded.MissEffectAttr: internal: on-miss side effect (crash damage etc.) — minor
excluded.BeatUpAttr: calc-variant: party multi-hit — is_multi_hit + has_variable_power cover it
excluded.AlwaysHitMinimizeAttr: calc-variant: sure-hit vs minimized targets — minor
excluded.CopyBiomeTypeAttr: calc-variant: covered by has_variable_type (Camouflage); the resulting type change is visible in the live types field
excluded.RespectAttackTypeImmunityAttr: covered: interacts with is_typeless handling — minor
excluded.AddArenaTrapTagHitAttr: covered: on-hit hazard variant (Stone Axe/Ceaseless Edge) -> sets_hazard via instanceof
excluded.FallDownAttr: covered: grounding is visible via the encoded is_grounded field
excluded.AddTypeAttr: covered: the added type is visible via the encoded added_type field
excluded.CopyTypeAttr: covered: resulting types visible in the live types field next decision
excluded.RemoveTypeAttr: covered: resulting types visible in the live types field (Burn Up is also flagged via curated BURNED_UP tag)
excluded.RandomLevelDamageAttr: covered: level-scaled damage adjacent to is_level_damage (Psywave) — minor
excluded.MatchHpAttr: BACKLOG: Endeavor (sets target HP to user's) — distinct damage semantics not flagged
excluded.SurviveDamageAttr: BACKLOG: False Swipe leaves-at-1HP — directly catch-relevant
excluded.EatBerryAttr: covered: steals_berry covers the Bug Bite/Pluck subclass; self-eat variants (Stuff Cheeks) minor
excluded.BoostHealAttr: covered: conditional heal — heal_ratio flags the heal; condition detail omitted
excluded.SwallowHealAttr: covered: stockpile-scaled heal (heal_ratio; stockpile is a curated tag)
excluded.SacrificialFullRestoreAttr: covered: is_sacrifice + heals party member (Healing Wish) — revives_ally flags the family
excluded.StatusCategoryOnAllyAttr: covered: ally-targeting status variant (Pollen Puff) — minor
excluded.CutHpStatStageBoostAttr: BACKLOG: Belly Drum family (HP-cost stat boost) — not represented in the static stat_change sums
excluded.AcupressureStatStageChangeAttr: calc-variant: random stat boost — static stat_change sums cannot represent it; minor
excluded.GrowthStatStageChangeAttr: calc-variant: weather-conditional stat boost magnitude; the base boost is in the stat_change sums
excluded.AwaitCombinedPledgeAttr: niche: Pledge combo coordination (doubles ally synergy)
excluded.ChillyReceptionAttr: covered: self_switch + weather_change flags both fire for Chilly Reception
excluded.InstantChargeAttr: covered: is_charging covers the family; instant-charge condition is a detail
excluded.HitsTagAttr: BACKLOG: hits-through-semi-invulnerable (Earthquake vs Dig) — targeting-relevant counterplay info
excluded.HitsTagForDoubleDamageAttr: BACKLOG: double damage vs semi-invulnerable/minimized — see HitsTagAttr
excluded.ExposedMoveAttr: BACKLOG: applies the exposure tags (see battler-tag backlog IGNORE_GHOST/IGNORE_DARK)
excluded.RemoveArenaTrapAttr: BACKLOG: hazard-clear attr distinct from RemoveArenaTagsAttr — verify removes_arena_tags captures Rapid Spin/Mortal Spin
excluded.RemoveScreensAttr: BACKLOG: screen removal (Brick Break/Raging Bull) distinct from removes_arena_tags — verify coverage
excluded.RepeatMoveAttr: niche: Instruct (commands target to repeat) — minor
excluded.FlameBurstAttr: niche: splash damage to ally-of-target (doubles detail)
excluded.BypassSleepAttr: covered: usable-while-asleep is reflected in the encoded per-move is_usable flag
